Pokémon Blue.description: The foundation of the Pokémon phenomenon. Journey through the Kanto region as you collect 8 Gym Badges, defeat the Elite Four, and thwart the criminal Team Rocket. This classic RPG features 151 original species to catch and train, offering deep turn-based strategic combat and a vast world to explore.

Pokémon Crystal.description: The definitive Johto experience. This expanded sequel to Gold and Silver introduces animated sprites, the Battle Tower, and a brand-new storyline centered on the legendary Suicune. Explore two full regions (Johto and Kanto), conquer 16 Gyms, and face the ultimate challenge atop Mt. Silver.

Pokémon Diamond.description: Enter the 4th generation in the vast Sinnoh region. Introducing 107 new species and the physical/special move split, this NDS milestone tasks you with stopping Team Galactic's plan to rewrite the universe using the power of Dialga, the master of time. Featuring the Pokétch and underground exploration.

Pokémon HeartGold.description: A high-fidelity remake of the Johto classic. HeartGold features updated graphics, following Pokémon, and the massive post-game Kanto region. Battle 16 Gym Leaders, capture the legendary Ho-Oh, and experience a journey that spans two entire continents with refined NDS mechanics.

Pokémon Leaf Green.description: Return to Kanto in this vibrant GBA remake of the original Green version. Featuring updated graphics and the brand-new Sevii Islands post-game, you'll embark on a quest to catch 151 species and defeat Team Rocket in the definitive version of the journey that started it all.

Pokémon Pearl.description: Explore the Sinnoh region and counter Team Galactic's plan to rewrite the universe. Diamond and Pearl introduced the global trade system and the physical/special split, changing Pokémon combat forever. Capture the legendary Palkia, master of space, in this 4th generation landmark.

Pokémon SoulSilver.description: The quintessential Johto remake. Journey across two full regions with your favorite Pokémon following you in the overworld. Encounter the legendary Lugia, defeat Team Rocket's remnants, and challenge Red in the ultimate battle atop Mt. Silver in this NDS masterpiece.

Pokémon Yellow.description: The special edition that brought the anime to life. Start your journey with a loyal Pikachu that follows you on screen, encounter Jessie and James of Team Rocket, and collect all three original starters in this nostalgic trip through the Kanto region.

Mario Kart: Super Circuit.description: Master the first portable entry in the Mario Kart series. Drift across 40 treacherous tracks—including 20 classic circuits from the original SNES masterpiece—as you battle for the gold in the high-stakes Grand Prix mode.

Pac-Man.description: Experience the timeless arcade legend that revolutionized the industry. Navigate the neon maze, consume power pellets to turn the tide against the relentless ghosts, and chase the legendary high score in this quintessential gaming masterpiece.

Sonic 3D Blast.description: Guide Sonic through isometric 3D environments to rescue the innocent Flickies from Dr. Robotnik's mechanical clutches. Harness the power of the Chaos Emeralds and navigate seven unique zones to restore peace to Flicky Island.

Pokémon Emerald.description: The definitive Hoenn experience. Emerald combines the best of Ruby and Sapphire, adding a brand-new storyline featuring Rayquaza and the massive Battle Frontier. Conquer two rival teams, Magma and Aqua, and experience animated sprites in this GBA masterpiece.

Pokémon FireRed.description: Return to Kanto in this high-fidelity GBA remake of the original Red version. Featuring updated graphics and the brand-new Sevii Islands post-game, you'll embark on a quest to catch 151 species and defeat Team Rocket in the definitive version of the journey that started it all.

Pokémon Platinum.description: The ultimate Sinnoh adventure. Platinum expands upon Diamond and Pearl with the mysterious Distortion World and the legendary Giratina. Featuring the Battle Frontier, updated character designs, and a faster engine, it is widely considered the best way to experience Gen 4.

Pokémon Ruby.description: Set in the tropical Hoenn region, Ruby introduces 135 new species and the era of double battles. Thwart Team Magma's plan to expand the world's landmass by awakening the continental deity Groudon. Explore volcanoes, build secret bases, and compete in Pokémon Contests.

Pokémon Sapphire.description: Adventure through Hoenn as Team Aqua attempts to flood the world by awakening the oceanic deity Kyogre. Sapphire features 135 new Pokémon, weather-based combat, and the introduction of abilities. Dive deep beneath the waves to uncover secrets in this GBA classic.

Pokemon Ultra Violet.description: The ultimate FireRed expansion for completionists. This comprehensive hack opens the world, allowing you to catch every single Pokémon from the first three generations in a single journey, featuring new areas and refined shiny hunting mechanics.

Super Mario Bros.description: The game that saved the industry. Embark on a legendary quest through the Mushroom Kingdom to rescue Princess Peach from the clutches of Bowser. Master the physics of the run-and-jump that defined the platforming genre for decades.

Super Mario Bros 2.description: Pick from four characters, each with unique abilities, and adventure through the dreamland of Subcon.

Super Mario Bros 3.description: Join Mario and Luigi in the greatest NES adventure ever told. Harness the power of the Tanooki suit and Frog suit to conquer eight unique kingdoms, defeat the Koopalings, and save Princess Peach from Bowser's massive airship fleet.

Legend of Zelda.description: Embark on an open-world quest as Link to collect the Triforce pieces and rescue Princess Zelda from Ganon.

Zelda II - The Adventure of Link.description: Venture into the shadowed lands of Hyrule in this unique side-scrolling odyssey. As Link must awaken the sleeping Princess Zelda, you'll master sword arts, cast powerful spells, and explore a vast overworld in a journey that blends platforming action with deep RPG growth.

Mega Man.description: Infiltrate the high-tech fortresses of six rogue Robot Masters as the Blue Bomber. In this foundational action-platformer, you must steal their unique abilities to confront the mad scientist Dr. Wily and restore peace to a world on the brink of robotic uprising.

Mega Man 2.description: The definitive legend of the Blue Bomber. Battle through eight iconic Robot Masters, navigate treacherous platforming gauntlets, and experience the quintessential action-platformer featuring an unforgettable soundtrack and the ultimate confrontation with Dr. Wily.

Contra.description: The ultimate test of survival in the face of an alien invasion. Grab the legendary Spread Gun and blast through jungle hideouts and mechanical fortresses with a friend in this pulse-pounding run-and-gun masterpiece that defined the genre.

Castlevania.description: Whip your way through the gothic halls of Dracula's castle as the legendary Simon Belmont. In this action-platforming classic, you'll face nightmare creatures of the night, master sub-weapons, and confront the Prince of Darkness himself to end his reign of terror.

Castlevania III - Draculas Curse.description: Play as Trevor Belmont and recruit allies to storm Dracula's castle in this branching-path masterpiece.

Metroid.description: Explore the claustrophobic, alien depths of planet Zebes as the bounty hunter Samus Aran. Discover powerful upgrades, navigate a non-linear labyrinth, and uncover the dark secrets of the Space Pirates in the genre-defining adventure that started it all.

Kirby's Adventure.description: Inhale the power of your enemies in this vibrant NES masterpiece. Journey across Dream Land as the adorable pink puffball Kirby, mastering dozens of copy abilities to defeat King Dedede and the mysterious Meta Knight to restore the Star Rod.

Donkey Kong.description: The game that introduced Mario! Climb ladders and dodge barrels to rescue Pauline from the giant ape.

Double Dragon.description: Fight through the streets to rescue your girlfriend in this legendary side-scrolling beat 'em up.

Tetris.description: The most addictive puzzle game ever created. Stack falling blocks, clear lines, chase the high score.
Tetris.difficulty: Easy to Learn, Hard to Master

Dr. Mario.description: Match colored capsules to eliminate viruses in this addictive puzzle game starring Dr. Mario.

Excitebike.description: Design custom tracks and race your motorbike over ramps and obstacles in this fast-paced racer.

Duck Hunt.description: Grab your Zapper and shoot ducks out of the sky while a mischievous dog laughs at your misses.

Ninja Gaiden.description: Experience the brutal path of the ninja as Ryu Hayabusa. Slash through hordes of enemies across cinematic acts, master wall-climbing and deadly Ninpo arts, and uncover the truth behind your father's disappearance in this punishingly difficult action classic.

Punch-Out!!.description: Step into the squared circle as the underdog Little Mac. Navigate the high-stakes world of professional boxing, decoding the unique patterns of 13 eccentric fighters to earn your shot at the ultimate heavyweight challenge: the legendary Mike Tyson.

Galaga.description: Defend Earth against waves of alien insects in this legendary space shooter sequel to Galaxian.

Battletoads.description: The notoriously difficult beat 'em up featuring the Battletoads. Smash enemies and survive the Turbo Tunnel.

Ice Climber.description: Climb ice-covered mountains with Popo and Nana, smashing blocks and dodging enemies along the way.

Balloon Fight.description: Float through the skies and pop enemy balloons in this charming arcade action game inspired by Joust.

Super Mario World.description: The SNES masterpiece that redefined platforming. Join Mario and his new companion Yoshi as they explore 96 secret exits across Dinosaur Land, mastering the Cape Feather and uncovering the mysteries of the Star Road to rescue Princess Peach.

Legend of Zelda - A Link to the Past.description: Hyrule's greatest top-down epic awaits. Traverse between the Light and Dark Worlds to solve ancient puzzles, conquer 12 daunting dungeons, and reclaim the Master Sword to defeat the dark wizard Agahnim and the demon king Ganon.

Super Metroid.description: The gold standard of atmospheric exploration. Return to planet Zebes as Samus Aran to recover the last Metroid hatchling. Navigate a hauntingly beautiful world, master advanced movement techniques, and face the towering horrors of the Space Pirate leaders.

Chrono Trigger.description: A time-traveling odyssey across the ages to prevent a global apocalypse. Join a diverse cast of heroes from the prehistoric past to the distant future, mastering dual and triple tech combos in a legendary RPG featuring 13 unique endings and a score for the ages.

Final Fantasy VI.description: An epic tale of magic, industrialization, and rebellion against a tyrannical empire. Follow 14 unique heroes as they face the chaotic nihilism of the villain Kefka across a world destined for ruin in one of the most emotional JRPGs ever told.

Donkey Kong Country.description: Swing through lush pre-rendered jungles and treacherous minecarts in this visual powerhouse. Join DK and Diddy Kong as they reclaim their banana hoard from King K. Rool, mastering animal buddies and uncovering secret rooms across a vibrant island.

Donkey Kong Country 2.description: Diddy and Dixie Kong set out to rescue DK from Kaptain K. Rool in this critically acclaimed sequel.

Super Mario Kart.description: The original kart racer that started it all. Battle your friends and race for the gold on iconic SNES tracks.

Street Fighter II Turbo.description: The world-renowned fighting phenomenon at its peak. Choose from 12 legendary warriors, master complex special moves, and engage in high-speed, technical combat to prove yourself as the ultimate champion in the definitive home version.

EarthBound.description: A quirky, modern-day JRPG odyssey that captures the heart of 1990s Americana. Join Ness and his friends as they use baseball bats and psychic powers to save the world from an intergalactic threat in a journey filled with unique humor and surreal charm.

Mega Man X.description: The evolution of the Blue Bomber. As X, you must hunt down Sigma's rogue Mavericks, wall-jumping and dashing through high-octane stages while collecting armor upgrades to prevent a catastrophic robot war.

Secret of Mana.description: Hack, slash, and cast magic in this real-time action RPG with 3-player co-op support.

F-Zero.description: Blaze through futuristic racetracks at blistering speeds in this Mode 7 racing pioneer.

Star Fox.description: Pilot the Arwing through Lylat System and defeat Andross in this groundbreaking Super FX 3D shooter.

Yoshi's Island.description: Guide baby Mario on Yoshi's back through beautifully hand-drawn worlds in this creative platformer.

Contra III - The Alien Wars.description: The most intense run-and-gun shooter on SNES. Blast aliens with dual-wielded weapons and ride missiles.

Super Castlevania IV.description: Simon Belmont returns with an 8-directional whip in this atmospheric SNES reimagining of the original.

ActRaiser.description: A unique blend of action-platforming and city-building simulation where you play as a deity.

Breath of Fire.description: A young dragon warrior named Ryu must unite heroes to defeat the Dark Dragon Clan in this classic JRPG.

Breath of Fire II.description: Build a town, recruit allies, and uncover a church conspiracy in this deeper sequel to Breath of Fire.

Metroid Fusion.description: Samus Aran becomes the prey as the terrifying X Parasite and its SA-X doppleganger hunt her through a derelict research station. Experience a tense, horror-infused chapter of the Metroid saga where survival depends on regaining your lost abilities.

Metroid - Zero Mission.description: A stunning reimagining of the original Metroid with new areas, Zero Suit Samus, and modern gameplay.

Advance Wars.description: Command armies in this addictive turn-based strategy game. Outsmart enemy COs in tactical battlefield combat.

Advance Wars 2.description: Black Hole strikes back with new COs and dual-strike powers in this superb strategy sequel.

Fire Emblem.description: The first Fire Emblem localized for the West. Lead Eliwood, Lyn, and Hector in tactical RPG battles.

Fire Emblem - The Sacred Stones.description: Twin siblings Eirika and Ephraim fight to save their kingdom in this accessible yet deep tactical RPG.

Golden Sun.description: Unleash the ancient power of Alchemy in this stunning handheld RPG. Harness elemental Psynergy to solve environmental puzzles, recruit mysterious Djinn to augment your party, and embark on an epic quest to prevent the release of a world-shattering force.

Golden Sun - The Lost Age.description: Continue the journey from Felix's perspective and discover the truth about Alchemy in this epic sequel.

Castlevania - Aria of Sorrow.description: Soma Cruz discovers his dark destiny within the solar eclipse. In this Metroidvania masterpiece, you must harvest the souls of your enemies to gain their powers, navigating a beautifully gothic castle to uncover the truth about the reincarnation of Dracula.

Castlevania - Circle of the Moon.description: Nathan Graves fights through Dracula's castle using the DSS card system in this dark Castlevania entry.

Final Fantasy Tactics Advance.description: Enter the magical world of Ivalice and build your clan in this deep tactical RPG with over 300 missions.

Kirby - Nightmare in Dream Land.description: A gorgeous GBA remake of Kirby's Adventure with enhanced visuals, new mini-games, and multiplayer.

Sonic Advance.description: The blue blur returns to his roots in this high-speed GBA platformer. Race across original zones as Sonic, Tails, Knuckles, or Amy, each with unique traversal abilities, and restore the balance of the world by collecting the elusive Chaos Emeralds.

Sonic Advance 2.description: The fastest entry in the series pushes speed to its limit. Master the new boost mechanics and aerial tricks across seven vibrant zones, and rescue the newcomer Cream the Rabbit from Dr. Eggman's clutches in this high-octane sequel.

Wario Land 4.description: Wario ventures into a mysterious golden pyramid in search of unimaginable wealth. In this highly inventive platformer, you must master Wario's unique transformations, smash through environmental puzzles, and beat the clock in heart-pounding timed escapes.

Mario & Luigi - Superstar Saga.description: Mario and Luigi embark on a hilarious journey to the neighboring Beanbean Kingdom to reclaim Princess Peach's voice. Master the unique 'Bros. Action' commands and timed button combos in this critically acclaimed RPG that blends strategy with comedic storytelling.

Harvest Moon - Friends of Mineral Town.description: Inherit your grandfather's farm and breathe new life into the charming community of Mineral Town. From raising livestock and cultivating crops to forging lifelong relationships, this quintessential life simulation offers a peaceful escape into the world of agriculture and romance.

Mega Man Zero.description: Awaken 100 years after the X wars in a dystopian future where Reploids are persecuted. As the legendary Zero, you must wield your Z-Saber with precision, master the Cyber Elf system, and lead the Resistance against a tyrannical regime in this punishingly difficult action classic.

Mega Man Battle Network.description: Jack into a digital world where the internet is the ultimate battlefield. In this innovative blend of RPG and real-time grid combat, you'll partner with MegaMan.EXE to delete viruses, collect powerful Battle Chips, and stop the cyber-terrorist organization WWW.

Legend of Zelda - The Minish Cap.description: Explore a vibrant Hyrule from a tiny new perspective. Guided by the talking hat Ezlo, Link must shrink to the size of the Minish to navigate a dual-sized world, forge the sacred Picori Blade, and stop the dark sorcerer Vaati from obtaining the Light Force.

Tactics Ogre - The Knight of Lodis.description: Command a brigade of knights in a deeply political tale of honor and betrayal. As Alphonse, your decisions will shape the fate of the Ovis region across branching paths, deep character customization, and strategic grid-based combat in this tactical JRPG gem.

Pokemon Black.description: Discover the Unova region with 156 all-new Pokémon and face the philosophical challenge of Team Plasma.

Pokemon White.description: Unova awaits with a fresh roster of Pokémon and a story that questions the ethics of Pokémon battles.

New Super Mario Bros.description: Mario returns to 2D in this modern take on classic platforming, with Mega Mushrooms and new power-ups.

Mario Kart DS.description: The ultimate portable racer hits the track with dual-screen action. Compete across 32 tracks—including iconic retro circuits—master the precision of drifting, and battle through the unique Mission Mode in this quintessential Mario Kart experience.

Zelda - Phantom Hourglass.description: Set sail after Wind Waker, using the DS touchscreen to solve puzzles and fight enemies in this nautical adventure.

Zelda - Spirit Tracks.description: Ride the Spirit Train across Hyrule and team up with Zelda's spirit to explore dungeons in this DS sequel.

Castlevania - Dawn of Sorrow.description: Soma Cruz returns to a mysterious cult's base to prevent the resurrection of a new Dark Lord. Harness the Tactical Soul system on the DS dual screens, using the Magic Seal system to banish powerful bosses and uncovering multiple endings in this beautifully gothic masterpiece.

Professor Layton and the Curious Village.description: Step into the village of St. Mystere and solve the mystery of the Golden Apple. Join the gentlemanly Professor Layton and his apprentice Luke as you unravel a web of secrets through over 130 brain-teasing puzzles and beautiful animated cutscenes.

Chrono Trigger DS.description: The definitive version of the greatest RPG ever, with new dungeons, endings, and touchscreen controls.

The World Ends with You.description: Survive the Reaper's Game in a stylish, neon-lit Shibuya. Master dual-screen psychic combat using collectible pins, influence fashion trends to gain advantages, and uncover a deep, character-driven story in one of the most unique and artistic JRPGs ever created.

Dragon Quest IX.description: Embark on a massive, customizable journey as a fallen guardian. Create your own hero and party members, master deep class systems, and explore a vast world filled with hidden treasure maps and ancient legends in this multiplayer-ready JRPG epic.

Kirby Super Star Ultra.description: Eight legendary Kirby adventures in one massive package. From the high-stakes 'Great Cave Offensive' to the epic 'Meta Knightmare Ultra,' experience the definitive version of the SNES classic with new modes, 3D cinematics, and refined gameplay.

Ace Attorney - Phoenix Wright.description: OBJECTION! Enter the high-stakes world of the courtroom as the rookie defense attorney Phoenix Wright. Investigate crime scenes, cross-examine eccentric witnesses, and present decisive evidence to uncover the truth and secure a 'Not Guilty' verdict for your clients.

Mega Man ZX.description: Transform between multiple Biometal forms in this exploration-heavy Mega Man action game.

Animal Crossing - Wild World.description: Build your dream village, catch bugs, fish, and decorate your home in this beloved life simulation.

Sonic Advance 3.description: The ultimate high-speed tag-team adventure. Partner Sonic with Tails, Knuckles, Amy, or Cream to combine unique abilities and zip through nine vibrant zones to stop Dr. Eggman from shattering the world using the power of the Chaos Emeralds.

1190 - Super Mario Advance 4 - Super Mar.description: The ultimate version of Super Mario Bros 3 with updated graphics, sound, and exclusive e-Reader levels.

Classic NES Series - Super Mario Bros.description: The original NES masterpiece, perfectly preserved for the Game Boy Advance. Experience the legend anywhere.

Crash Bandicoot: Purple.description: The ultimate crossover event! Crash Bandicoot and Spyro the Dragon join forces to stop the combined threat of Dr. Neo Cortex and Ripto. Master a variety of unique minigames and collectible cards in this innovative portal-jumping adventure.

GTA: Chinatown Wars.description: Navigate the gritty underworld of Liberty City as Huang Lee, the son of a murdered Triad boss. In this tale of crime and betrayal, you must reclaim your family's stolen heirloom sword while surviving a violent power struggle across the neon-lit criminal landscape.

The Legend of Zelda: Phantom Hourglass.description: Set sail on the SS Linebeck in a direct sequel to The Wind Waker. Rescue Tetra from a spectral Ghost Ship, explore uncharted islands in the Realm of the Ocean King, and use the titular Phantom Hourglass to navigate deadly temples and solve puzzles with the DS touchscreen.
